cfg.section.web.title: Web UI
cfg.web.about: /web opens a browser app on the same engine as the terminal, MCP, ACP and the gateway. It runs as a child process on the loopback interface with a token minted per run, bound to the terminal's saved session so both surfaces continue the same conversation. chatcli web serves it without a terminal.
